resources.string: This app uses your front camera to warn you when another person may be looking at your phone screen while you use WhatsApp, Instagram, Chrome, games and other apps.

Everything happens on your phone. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload anything.

Your face is saved only as a list of numbers (not a photo), and it is encrypted.

Photos of other people are never saved: each camera picture is checked in memory and thrown away.

The Android camera indicator stays visible while the app watches.
What it can and cannot do

It only sees what the front camera sees. People beside you, behind you or outside the camera view cannot be detected.

It cannot tell where eyes are looking. It only checks which way a head is turned.

It can make mistakes, so never rely on it as your only protection.

If another app (for example a video call) takes the camera, protection pauses until the camera is free.
We ask only for what is needed, and we explain why. You can also do this later from the main screen.
Needed to see faces in front of your phone. Pictures are never saved or sent anywhere.
Needed to show that protection is running and to show the Privacy Alert.
Android will not ask again. Open the app settings, tap Permissions, and allow it there.
Protection paused: camera in use by another app
The status is re-checked every few seconds. Android can stop apps at any time, so protection is never guaranteed.
To start: allow the camera and notifications, and create your face profile.
Face profile: saved on this phone (encrypted)
The face model file is missing. Follow README.md, section \"Download the face model\", then build the app again.
Stop protection first. The camera can only be used by one screen at a time.
Battery optimization is ON. Android may stop the app to save battery.
Battery optimization is OFF for this app.
Sit in a bright place and look at the camera. We take 5 pictures from different angles. The pictures are NOT saved. Only a list of numbers is kept, encrypted.
Slowly turn your head to the LEFT
Now turn your head to the RIGHT
Tilt your head UP a little
Now tilt your head DOWN a little
If left and right feel swapped, it does not matter. Both sides are captured.
No face found. Move into the picture.
Only one face please. Make sure nobody else is in view.

Too bright. Avoid strong light on your face.
Something went wrong. Please try again.

Choosing a sensitivity level above resets these numbers.
Match threshold: %1$s (higher = stricter about who counts as you)
Alert when %1$d of the last %2$d pictures agree
This erases your encrypted face profile and its key from this phone, and stops protection. You can create a new profile later.
People beside or behind the phone, or outside the camera view, cannot be detected.

Eye gaze is not used. Eye tracking is not reliable on phone cameras, so the app only checks which way a head is turned. Someone facing the screen may not really be looking at it, and someone glancing sideways may be missed.
The front camera can only be used by one app at a time. If you start a video call or open the camera, protection pauses and continues by itself when the camera is free.

Protection pauses when the screen is off or the battery is low, and stops when you tap Stop. After the phone restarts, Android does not allow a camera service to start by itself. You get a notification: tap it to restart.
Android shows a camera indicator (green dot) while the camera is used. This is a system rule and the app does not hide it.
Privacy: no internet permission, no photos saved, nothing uploaded. Your face profile is a list of numbers, encrypted with a key that stays in Android Keystore.
False alarms and missed alerts can happen, for example in dark rooms, with sunglasses or masks. Tune the sensitivity in Settings.

Android saves battery by stopping apps that run in the background for a long time. That can stop Privacy Guard without warning. If you turn battery optimization off for this app, Android is less likely to stop it. The app then uses a little more battery.
Battery optimization is ON for this app. Android may stop it.
Battery optimization is OFF for this app. Good.

Some phone brands (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, Samsung and others) add their own autostart or background-restriction switches. If protection keeps stopping, look for them in the app settings and allow them. Even then, nothing can promise uninterrupted monitoring.
Privacy Alert: Someone may be looking at your screen.
